about: Which file names are env files and which of those are samples (AR-1: closed variety is a data row). Read only through env_probe.env_file_kind (axis 37). A name is an env file when it equals one of `exact`, starts with one of `prefixes` or ends with one of `suffixes` (case as written). An env file is a SAMPLE when any dot-separated part of its name, lower-cased, is in `sample_markers`; so is the bare form `<bare_stem>.<marker>` (env.example). A sample is never classified as an env file.
